parameters.name: imap_conn_id
parameters.description: The :ref:`imap connection id <howto/connection:imap>` that contains the information used to authenticate the client.

parameters.name: attachment_name
parameters.description: The name of the attachment that will be checked.

parameters.name: check_regex
parameters.description: If set to True the attachment's name will be parsed as regular expression. Through this you can get a broader set of attachments that it will look for than just only the equality of the attachment name.

parameters.name: mail_folder
parameters.description: The mail folder in where to search for the attachment.

parameters.name: mail_filter
parameters.description: If set other than 'All' only specific mails will be checked. See :py:meth:`imaplib.IMAP4.search` for details.
